```python
from flask import Flask

app = Flask(__name__)

@app.route('/')
def hello():
    return 'Hello, World!', 200

if __name__ == '__main__':
    client = app.test_client()
    response = client.get('/')
    assert response.status_code == 200
    print(f"Status code: {response.status_code}")
    print("Test passed!")
```
